turns.question: Which customer opened the most CRM emails between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many did they open?
turns.answer: No single customer leads: customers 1, 4 and 9 tied for the most CRM email opens from 20 September to 3 October 2026, with 1 email opened each (customer actions filtered to email_open). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
